highlights.text: Take any segment of population, impose strict yet clear definitions on their particular characteristics, then target them for compliance. Bribe the weak to expose the strong. Kill the strong, and the rest are yours. Move on to the next segment.

Redmask regarded the foreigner. ‘Your people have a strange relationship with your gods.’
‘To create a professional army? Yes, it’s essential, but it will change everything. Your people, your culture, everything.’ He paused, then added in a dry, mocking tone, ‘You’ll need a new song.’
‘And so my followers died – oh, how they have died. Across half the world, their blood soaked the earth. And I could do nothing. I can do nothing.’

Meckros warrior had called a Seguleh. First Empire word, that. The Anvil.
Rhulad falls – the whole Sengar bloodline obliterated – and then…Hannan Mosag. For his crimes. Honour can be won – I will see to that. This is how it must be.

Toc scratched the scar where an eye had been. ‘Are your wits addled by age?’ A grunt. ‘I know secrets.’ ‘Me too.’

Still, it was odd that the ancient undead warrior was walking at all. Easier traversing this wasteland as dust. Maybe it’s too damp. Maybe it’s no fun being mud. I’ll have to ask it that.

In Bast Fulmar, there is no water of magic, no stream of power from which to steal. All used up, all taken to quench the fire that is life. Our enemy is not aware. They will find the truth this day.
